description: Add placeholder image generation so the pipeline never aborts due to missing visual assets. When no product images can be scraped and AI image generation fails, generate a simple colored placeholder image locally (using raw PNG/Buffer creation without external deps like canvas/sharp) and upload it to R2 so the video always completes.
steps: Create a new file apps/web/src/lib/assets/placeholder-image.ts that exports a function generatePlaceholderImage(opts: { productName: string; userId: string; width?: number; height?: number }): Promise<string> which creates a minimal valid PNG image (solid color) in memory, uploads it to R2, and returns the presigned download URL. Use a raw buffer approach to create a valid PNG without needing canvas or sharp (a simple 1080x1920 solid-color PNG can be generated using raw IDAT/deflate).

The placeholder should be a simple solid color image (e.g., a dark gradient-like solid #1a1a2e or branded color). Since we cannot easily do text rendering without canvas/sharp, a solid color background is sufficient - the overlay text from scene-planner will add text on top during FFmpeg composition.

In apps/web/src/lib/ugc/orchestrate.ts, modify the gatherAssets function: after the existing image gathering logic, if BOTH productImages and lifestyleImages are empty, call generatePlaceholderImage to create a fallback and add it to productImages
Remove the early abort check in orchestrateUGCVideo that returns 'failed' when no assets are found (the pipeline should never fail just because of missing images now)

Update the orchestrate.test.ts test 'aborts early when no visual assets are available' to instead verify the pipeline continues with a placeholder (or replace with a test that verifies placeholder generation is called)

Add a test file apps/web/src/lib/assets/placeholder-image.test.ts that verifies: (a) the function returns a presigned URL string, (b) it calls presignUpload and fetch PUT, (c) the generated buffer is a valid PNG (starts with PNG magic bytes)
Ensure the compose.ts downloadFile function can handle the presigned URLs returned by the placeholder (it already handles any HTTP URL, so this should work)
acceptance_criteria: When no product images are scraped and AI image generation returns null, a placeholder image is generated and uploaded to R2
The pipeline no longer aborts/fails due to missing visual assets
The placeholder is a valid PNG file that FFmpeg can process
The orchestrate function proceeds to scene planning and composition even with only the placeholder
All existing tests pass (with the abort test updated)
New tests verify placeholder generation logic
